svg.title: Auto Switch — exact breadboard layout
svg.desc: Headered Pico W bridges c3 to c22 and h3 to h22, USB upward. Breadboard holes and jumper IDs match the placement table. Motor power harness remains beside the breadboard. Side power rails are unused.
svg.text: Exact hole addresses for your headered Pico. USB socket points UP. Components shown from above.
Power OFF while wiring. Motor supply wiring stays beside the breadboard. Side + / − rails are NOT USED.
J = male/male jumper on the breadboard. L = lead to the separate power harness. Crossing cables do not connect.
The centre trench separates those strips.
Row 45 is NOT connected to row 46.
Keep columns a/b and i/j accessible.
Do not use any side power rail.
Existing power harness · follow board silkscreen
Master VIN receives fused battery positive.
VIN ← 5 V VOUT → servo + ON ← L4
Only signal wire → L5 / breadboard j35

g.text: Only signal wire → L6 / breadboard j45

svg.text: KEEP THESE ON THE POWER HARNESS
C1 470 µF: + to 5 V, − stripe to PGND
D2 1N5819: stripe to SERVO_5V; other to PGND
Short, insulated 22 AWG motor power wires.
PGND joins battery −, both switches, regulator,
both servos and the three passive returns above.
MASTER ON unused · REG ENABLE unused
Check that your board has the same row labels.
Do not mirror or rotate the Pico relative to this view.
Bands show nominal 1% parts; verify actual values.
Leads shown as routes, not pre-cut wire lengths.
Bench layout only. It is not the soldered Perma-Proto layout inside the printed enclosure. Verify continuity before applying power.
